name: Suou Mio
source:
A resident of Room 301. A good-natured person whose favorite things are drinking, smoking, and big boobs. With excellent communication skills, he has the potential to become drinking buddies with nearly anyone despite such a harsh world. Though he can be a bit lazy and troublesome, he means well.

[Source [URL=http://www.zombilica.com/games/nienomati/character.html] official website profile.[/URL]]
